name: TRIO Upward Bound
what_you_do: Get tutoring, advising and help with college and financial aid forms during the school year. In summer, live on the USD campus, take up to 4 classes to get ready for the next school year, and go on a field trip each week.
who_can_apply: Current 9th, 10th or 11th graders at Kearny High Educational Complex or Hoover High School. 8th graders who will go to Kearny or Hoover next year are encouraged to apply. Your family must meet federal income guidelines, or neither parent or guardian has a U.S. college degree.
pay_detail: Cost and pay are not stated on the USD pages.
duration: School year services plus a summer program where students live on campus
deadline_text: Applications for Kearny and Hoover are reviewed on a rolling basis for the next school year. No closing date is posted.
how_to_apply: Check the rules on the Prospective Students page, then fill out the online application for your high school (Kearny or Hoover) on the Apply page. Staff follow up after you apply. Questions go to the Assistant Director for your school (emails on the Apply page).
notes: To stay in the program, go to a monthly meeting after school. Go to at least one workshop or event each fall and spring, and keep at least a 2.5 GPA. USD says it serves 120 students in the school year and 100 in summer.
